name: flovo-render-worker
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg && pip install -r requirements.txt
postStartCommand: nohup python3 app.py > /tmp/app.log 2>&1 & sleep 8 && gh codespace ports visibility 8080:public -c $CODESPACE_NAME >> /tmp/gh.log 2>&1 || echo FAILED >> /tmp/gh.log
